lines: This plan covers 3 days, starting today.
You cook on Tuesday and Saturday, and that is what was kept.
To stay inside it, expensive proteins give first, then out-of-season produce, then variety — never the portions.

dishes.name: Tomato eggs and toast
dishes.title: Eggs, tomatoes and toast
dishes.method: Warm the tomatoes in a small pan with butter, season lightly, then cook the eggs into soft scrambles. Toast the bread and serve everything hot.
dishes.why: It gives the day a warm, named breakfast with a protein anchor and fits the house rule that breakfasts stay small and warm.

dishes.name: Chicken rice lunch bowl
dishes.title: Chicken, rice, roast peppers and courgette
dishes.method: Reheat one portion of the chicken, rice and roast vegetables, then finish with lemon juice. Keep it hot and serve straight away.
dishes.why: It is a loud vegetable bowl with the starch placed where the training day needs it, and it uses the same batch without repeating the cooking.

dishes.name: Traybake dinner bowls
dishes.title: Chicken, rice, roast peppers and courgette
dishes.method: Reheat one portion of the chicken, rice and roast vegetables, then add lemon just before serving.
dishes.why: A second batch meal keeps the evening quick while staying varied enough from lunch for a human week.

dishes.name: Tomato eggs and toast
dishes.title: Eggs, tomatoes and toast

dishes.why: Thursday has no cooking session outside the repainting disruption, so breakfast stays fresh and fast.

dishes.name: Chicken rice lunch bowl
dishes.title: Chicken, rice, roast peppers and courgette

dishes.why: It avoids oven use while the kitchen is being repainted and keeps lunch anchored to a cooked protein.

dishes.name: Lemon chicken dinner wraps
dishes.title: Chicken, roast peppers and courgette, flatbreads and yoghurt
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and vegetables in a pan, warm the flatbreads, then spread with yoghurt and fill them. Finish with lemon.
dishes.why: With the oven unavailable, this gives a proper warm dinner without asking for oven space.

dishes.name: Tomato eggs and toast
dishes.title: Eggs, tomatoes and toast
dishes.method: Warm the tomatoes in a small pan with butter, season lightly, then cook the eggs into soft scrambles. Toast the bread and serve everything hot.
dishes.why: It stays within the week’s quick-breakfast pattern and avoids a second cold plate in a row.

dishes.name: Rice chicken lunch bowls
dishes.title: Chicken, rice, roast peppers and courgette
dishes.method: Reheat one portion of chicken, rice and vegetables in a pan with a splash of water, then serve with lemon.
dishes.why: It uses the last safe rice portions on the final day they can be eaten and keeps lunch substantial.

dishes.name: Chicken and veg wraps
dishes.title: Chicken, roast peppers and courgette, flatbreads and yoghurt
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken and vegetables in a pan, warm the flatbreads, then spread with yoghurt and fill them. Finish with lemon.
dishes.why: It changes the format so the same batch does not feel like a repeat plate, while still using the cooked food before it goes over time.

dishes.name: Tomato egg pots
dishes.title: Eggs with tomatoes
dishes.method: Warm the tomatoes, then make six soft scrambled eggs in the pan and cool slightly before boxing. This makes three breakfast portions with tomato on the side.
dishes.why: It gives the week an easy cooked breakfast anchor without using the broken oven.
